original.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 bumps the pinned mkdocs-material dependency used by the /hack/api-docs documentation tooling from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11, with no effect on the deployed operator.

decision.reason: [ev-7fa7364f4707] describes a Dependabot chore that bumps mkdocs-material from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11 in /hack/api-docs. That is a pinned version in the repository's tooling for building the API docs. It is not a dependency or interaction of the shipped external-secrets product with another product, so the product-relationship subject misreads what changed. No other subject family fits a docs-build tool pin, so no corrected assertion follows from the evidence.
